text:
isabel: FYI I'm opening a refactor PR to consolidate a few legacy TF modules and standardize provider pinning across infra. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4823 :wave:

raj: thanks — quick scope check: are we hoisting the aws provider to root or introducing a provider shim module?

isabel: hoisting to root with a compatibility shim for modules that still expect aliased providers. strategy: add root `required_providers` + `provider "aws" {}` at root and add provider aliases in module call sites where needed.

leo: will this require a state move for modules that were using aliased providers?

isabel: probably just a plan to be safe. steps in PR description. if state move needed we'll run: `terraform state mv module.old.module_name module.new.module_name` as a one-off. trying to avoid bulk state surgery.

sylvia: can you paste the example provider block you plan to land?

isabel: sure — here's the root block I put in the PR:
```hcl
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aws = {
      source  = "hashicorp/aws"
      version = ">= 5.0, < 6.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "aws" {
  region = var.aws_region
}
```

raj: ok nice. two follow-ups: 1) lockfile regen — do we pin in the repo or expect CI to update `.terraform.lock.hcl`? 2) secrets wiring for k8s secrets that modules create (we had one module write to `k8s::secrets` path previously).

isabel: plan is to commit the regenerated `.terraform.lock.hcl` from my machine (matching our CI runner) in the same PR. CI will run `terraform init -upgrade` to verify. for k8s secrets, the module interface changed: instead of returning raw secret data we now return a secret name + namespace and let a central k8s-sync job create the Secret resource. minimizes TF-managed secret data in state.

leo: can you show the new output shape? makes reviews easier.

isabel: output snippet:
```hcl
output "db_secret_ref" {
  value = {
    name      = aws_secretsmanager_secret.example.name
    namespace = var.k8s_namespace
  }
}
```

sylvia: for the k8s-sync side, we need the manifest shape. sample k8s Secret the sync job expects: 
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: example-db-creds
  namespace: services
stringData:
  username: myuser
  password: secret
```

raj: thanks. one more: deployment rollout plan? I want to avoid app downtime if the module output shape changes.

isabel: rollout plan in PR: canary deploy by service. steps: 1) land TF change in staging and apply (no state moves). 2) deploy k8s-sync to create secrets from new outputs. 3) patch a canary service to read new secret name. 4) promote. fallback: keep old secret path for 2 weeks and sync both ways if needed.

leo: do we need a DB migration window or is this purely wiring?

isabel: purely wiring. creds not changing. just how consumers locate them.

infra-bot: deploy check: all CI passed for PR #4823 — `init/plan` ok on staging workspace.

raj: I'll do a quick review this morning. if anything blocks I'll comment inline. otherwise :shipit: when CI green and lockfile included.

sylvia: small nudge — don't forget to update the module README with the new output contract and a migration note for consumers.

isabel: good call, adding that now. thanks team! :tada:
